message:
Let me check if there's a built fuzzer binary and the submit script:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace -name "submit.sh" -o -name "*config_fuzzer*" -o -name "*fuzzer*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.cc" | head -20 && echo "---" && ls -la /workspace/</｜｜DSML｜｜>
